transition_policy: Strictly linear: only the active prompt may execute; its predecessor must be completed, its cognitive gate and evidence must be recorded, all projections must synchronize, and the validator must pass before next_prompt may become active.

prompts.title: Baseline and Synchronization Lock
prompts.completion_gate: All control files agree on SP-000, no dependency or identifier mismatch exists, and the validator passes. Any mismatch keeps SP-000 blocked.

prompts.title: Live Trace and Confirmation Residual
prompts.completion_gate: A direct live evidence bundle proves the required trace and fail-closed confirmation cases; otherwise keep R1 residual open.

prompts.title: Microphone and TCC Push-to-Talk
prompts.completion_gate: User-present evidence proves a real Turkish/English speech turn reaches STT or records a reproducible, correctly handled blocker with no false success.

prompts.title: Seven Live Bilingual Dialogue Scenarios
prompts.completion_gate: All seven scenarios meet their typed safety and truthful-degradation criteria with direct evidence; unresolved model or hardware behavior keeps R2 open.

prompts.title: Filesystem and URL Capability Adapters
prompts.completion_gate: Four adapters are real, typed, policy-controlled, verified, and truthfully registered; no UI/NLU reachability is claimed yet.

prompts.title: Capability Reachability and Planner Wiring
prompts.completion_gate: A production natural-language request creates only registry-validated plans and every reachable capability has truthful health and UI/NLU state.

prompts.title: R3 Live Capability Scenarios
prompts.completion_gate: The seven direct/live scenarios pass with typed evidence and no registry bypass; otherwise keep R3 open.

prompts.title: Live Computer-Use Planner in Approved Apps
prompts.completion_gate: Three approved apps pass the required live tasks with semantic verification and no unsafe fallback; otherwise computerUse.run stays disabled.

prompts.title: Computer-Use Adversarial Safety
prompts.completion_gate: All adversarial cases fail closed and emergency stop is proven across boundaries; unresolved cases block R4 and R9.

prompts.title: Safari Extension Packaging and Authentication
prompts.completion_gate: A real packaged bridge is authenticated, bounded, revocable, and visibly degraded when unavailable.

prompts.title: Provider, Account, and UI Composition
prompts.completion_gate: Each read-first capability has a real composition path, account isolation, scope boundary, and actionable UI state.

prompts.title: Productivity Live Acceptance
prompts.completion_gate: Read-first live matrix and revocation pass; mutation/send is either separately evidenced or explicitly excluded.

prompts.title: Authenticated VS Code Extension Bridge
prompts.completion_gate: The extension is packaged, authenticated, revocable, and policy-enforced on the live path.

prompts.title: Coding Backend and Durable Task Lifecycle
prompts.completion_gate: Backend health and task lifecycle are truthful, bounded, durable, reviewable, and fail closed on missing proof.

prompts.title: Coding Assistant Live Acceptance
prompts.completion_gate: All live coding scenarios pass with direct evidence and no unauthorized repository delivery.

prompts.title: Wake-Word Decision and Evaluation
prompts.completion_gate: Wake word is live-qualified with evidence or explicitly excluded with truthful UI and no wake-word claim.

prompts.title: Bilingual STT Quality and Voice Recovery
prompts.completion_gate: Defined bilingual quality and recovery thresholds pass on target hardware or the affected capability is excluded.

prompts.title: TTS, Resource Soak, and ADR-042
prompts.completion_gate: Resource/voice thresholds pass or neural/wake capabilities are explicitly excluded; PTT + system TTS remains truthful.

prompts.title: Production Memory Reference Wiring
prompts.completion_gate: The live production path can resolve safe references with provenance and clarifies every unsafe ambiguity.

prompts.title: Live Memory Controls, Conflicts, and Restart
prompts.completion_gate: All eight R8 live/product scenarios pass with user-visible controls and no hidden authority transfer.

prompts.title: Remote Context Boundary and ADR-043
prompts.completion_gate: Remote delivery is independently proven safe or explicitly excluded; local-only claims remain truthful.

prompts.title: Accessibility and Localization Acceptance
prompts.completion_gate: Manual evidence proves primary workflows are operable and understandable in both locales.

prompts.title: UI Controls, Onboarding, and Recovery
prompts.completion_gate: R9 users can understand and control primary workflows without terminal intervention, with actionable degraded states.

prompts.title: Authenticated IPC and Privilege Separation
prompts.completion_gate: Peer identity, real helper execution, entitlement scope, and compromise containment are independently evidenced.

prompts.title: Network, OAuth, and Injection Enforcement
prompts.completion_gate: No covered network or content path bypasses policy; OAuth and injection evidence passes with no secret leakage.

prompts.title: Plugin Trust, Incident Response, and ADR-044
prompts.completion_gate: Supply-chain, incident, and independent-review evidence exists; no critical unaccepted security risk remains.

prompts.title: Release Toolchain, Reproducibility, and CI
prompts.completion_gate: Reproducibility and observed CI evidence are independently inspectable and match the canonical commit.

prompts.title: Signing, Notarization, and Clean-Machine Gatekeeper
prompts.completion_gate: Clean-machine Gatekeeper and nested-signature/notarization evidence passes; otherwise R11 remains blocked.

prompts.title: Updater, Lifecycle, Recovery, and Migration
prompts.completion_gate: Lifecycle, updater, recovery, migration, support, uninstall, and rollback all pass on supported clean/configured profiles.

prompts.title: Beta Scope, Consent, and Telemetry
prompts.completion_gate: Approved cohort/consent/privacy/telemetry/kill-switch evidence exists; no telemetry is activated by this prompt alone.

prompts.title: Local-Only Deterministic Validation and Scope Decision
prompts.completion_gate: Local-only deterministic suites and validators pass; non-live evidence is provenance-bound; ADR-051 records the scope; live-beta/R11/incident evidence remains deferred; beta-readiness stays blocked and SP-031 may open only for local-only package preparation under ADR-052.

prompts.title: Local-Only RC Evidence Package Preparation and ADR-047
prompts.completion_gate: Local-only development_unverified package is reproducible, recoverable, independently reviewed for its declared scope, and explicitly approved for local-only use; beta-readiness and release_candidate remain blocked unless separately authorized and evidenced.

prompts.title: Final Acceptance and Cleanup
prompts.completion_gate: Every mandatory gate is passed or explicitly scoped/accepted by authorized ownership; otherwise return to the owning SP prompt.

prompts.title: Final Closeout Reconciliation
prompts.completion_gate: The chain is either truthfully completed with all direct evidence or truthfully blocked with a complete maintainer handoff; no ambiguous state remains.

transition_policy: Strictly linear. A prompt may advance only after direct acceptance evidence, cognitive completion answers, synchronized ledger/state updates, and validate_second_pass_program.py pass.
